name: space-icon-popover-captures
description: Visual capture of the space icon popover's Icon tab and Emoji tab, for a light/dark review pass. Not an assertion scenario - the frames are the artifact.

actions.note: EMPTY SPACE below the rows, which opens the space menu

actions.expression: (() => { const item = [...document.querySelectorAll('.ctxitem')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Change Space Icon'); if (!item) { return 'no item'; } item.click(); const tab = document.querySelector('.spiconpop .spicon-seg .settings-seg-option[data-tab="icon"]'); if (tab) { tab.click(); } return document.querySelector('.spiconpop') ? 'open' : 'not open'; })()
(() => { const tab = document.querySelector('.spiconpop .spicon-seg .settings-seg-option[data-tab="emoji"]'); if (!tab) { return 'no-emoji-tab'; } tab.click(); return 'switched'; })()
